sentences.zh: 821 長慶元年辛丑

translations.literal: 821 CE, first year of the Changqing reign, xinchou year.
translations.idiomatic: 821 CE, first year of the Changqing reign, xinchou year.

sentences.zh: 正月壬戌，俛罷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: First month, day renxu, Fu was removed and made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the first month, Fu was removed from office and appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，文昌檢校刑部尚書、同平章事、西川節度使，戶部侍郎、翰林學士杜元穎守戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, day renwu, Wenchang was acting Minister of Justice, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Xichuan; Du Yuanying, Vice Minister of Revenue and Hanlin Academician, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the second month, Wenchang held the posts of acting Minister of Justice, Grand Councilor, and Xichuan military commissioner; Du Yuanying, Vice Minister of Revenue and Hanlin Academician, was named Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，諸道鹽鐵轉運使、刑部尚書王播守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingyin, Wang Bo, Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and Minister of Justice, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the tenth month, Wang Bo, transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits and Minister of Justice, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 822 二年壬寅

translations.literal: 822 CE, second year, renyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 822 CE, second year, renyin year.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，植罷為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi, Zhi was removed and made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the second month, Zhi was removed from office and appointed Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎元稹守工部侍郎、同中書門下平章事，元穎為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Works Yuan Zhen was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Yuanying became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhen, Vice Minister of Works, was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Yuanying became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，度守司空兼門下侍郎、平章事，播檢校尚書右僕射、平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuwu, Du was appointed Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor; Bo was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the third month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor; Wang Bo was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，度罷為尚書左僕射，稹罷為同州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiazi, Du was removed and made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhen was removed and made prefect of Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the sixth month, Du was removed and appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Zhen was removed and appointed prefect of Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書李逢吉守門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Li Fengji, Minister of War, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fengji, Minister of War, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，夷簡分司東都。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, Yijian was assigned to nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Li Yijian was assigned to nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，度守司空。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuwu, Du was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the third month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，弘卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengyin, Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the twelfth month, Hong died.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，御史中丞牛僧孺為戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Third month, day renxu, Censor-in-Chief Niu Sengru was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the third month, Niu Sengru, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，復判戶部。

translations.literal: Day dingmao, he again took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, he again took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十月己丑，元穎檢校禮部尚書、同平章事、西川節度使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jichou, Yuanying was made acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the tenth month, Yuanying was appointed acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and Xichuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，僧孺為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, Sengru became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Sengru became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，度守司空、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao, Du was appointed Minister of Works and military commissioner of Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the eighth month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Works and military commissioner of Shannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，吏部侍郎李程，戶部侍郎、判度支竇易直，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao, Li Cheng, Vice Minister of Personnel, and Dou Yizhi, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, were both made Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month, Li Cheng, Vice Minister of Personnel, and Dou Yizhi, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, were both appointed Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，度同平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen, Du was made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the sixth month, Pei Du was made Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，逢吉為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, Fengji was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Li Fengji was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，橫海軍節度使李光顏守司徒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen, Li Guangyan, military commissioner of the Transverse Sea Army, was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the sixth month, Li Guangyan, military commissioner of the Transverse Sea Army, was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 正月乙卯，僧孺檢校禮部尚書、同平章事、武昌節度使。

translations.literal: First month, day yimao, Sengru was made acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the first month, Sengru was appointed acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and Wuchang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，程守中書侍郎，易直守門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day xinyou, Cheng was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat; Yizhi was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Li Cheng was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Dou Yizhi Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月庚午，易直罷度支。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengwu, Yizhi ceased acting as controller of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the seventh month, Yizhi ceased serving as acting controller of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，度守司空。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei, Du was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the second month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，裴度守司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the second month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，度判度支。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen, Du took charge of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, Pei Du took charge of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，程檢校兵部尚書、同平章事、河東節度使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu, Cheng was made acting Minister of War, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the ninth month, Li Cheng was appointed acting Minister of War, Grand Councilor, and Hedong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，逢吉檢校司空、同平章事、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen, Fengji was made acting Minister of Works and Grand Councilor and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the eleventh month, Fengji was appointed acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, and Shannan East military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，兵部侍郎翰林學士韋處厚為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu, Wei Chuhou, Vice Minister of War and Hanlin Academician, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month, Wei Chuhou, Vice Minister of War and Hanlin Academician, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚申，度兼門下侍郎，易直尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, Du also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery; Yizhi was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Pei Du also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery, and Yizhi was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月戊寅，光顏卒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuyin, Guangyan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the ninth month, Guangyan died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，淮南節度副大使王播為尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi, Wang Bo, deputy military commissioner of Huainan, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the sixth month, Wang Bo, deputy military commissioner of Huainan, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月丙寅，度罷度支。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingyin, Du ceased acting as controller of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the tenth month, Pei Du ceased serving as acting controller of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 正月癸未，天平軍節度使烏重胤守司徒。

translations.literal: First month, day guiwei, Wu Chongyin, military commissioner of the Tianping Army, was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the first month, Wu Chongyin, military commissioner of the Tianping Army, was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，重胤卒。

translations.literal: Day bingyin, Chongyin died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Chongyin died.

sentences.zh: 十月癸酉，易直檢校尚書左僕射、平章事、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiyou, Yizhi was made acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the tenth month, Yizhi was appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Shannan East military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，處厚薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renshen, Chuhou died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the twelfth month, Chuhou died.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，兵部侍郎、翰林學士路隋守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, Lu Sui, Vice Minister of War and Hanlin Academician, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Lu Sui, Vice Minister of War and Hanlin Academician, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，武寧軍節度使王智興守司徒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu, Wang Zhixing, military commissioner of the Wuning Army, was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the ninth month, Wang Zhixing, military commissioner of the Wuning Army, was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，吏部侍郎李宗閔同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu, Li Zongmin, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the eighth month, Li Zongmin, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，元穎貶邵州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiyou, Yuanying was demoted to prefect of Shao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the twelfth month, Yuanying was demoted to prefect of Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，智興為太傅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi, Zhixing was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the eleventh month, Zhixing was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 正月辛卯，牛僧孺為兵部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, day xinmao, Niu Sengru was made Minister of War and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the first month, Niu Sengru was appointed Minister of War and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，度平章軍國重事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei, Du was made Grand Councilor for State and Military Affairs of Importance.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the sixth month, Pei Du was made Grand Councilor for State and Military Affairs of Importance.

sentences.zh: 己酉，隋為門下侍郎，宗閔為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, Sui became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Zongmin became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Sui became Vice Director of the Chancellery and Zongmin Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，尚書右丞宋申錫同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guiwei, Song Shenxi, Right Assistant in the Department of State Affairs, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the seventh month, Song Shenxi, Right Assistant in the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，度為司徒兼侍中、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu, Du was made Minister of Education and Palace Attendant and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the ninth month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Education and Palace Attendant and military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，檢校司徒、平章事李載義守太保。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jisi, Li Zaiyi, acting Minister of Education and Grand Councilor, was appointed Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the sixth month, Li Zaiyi, acting Minister of Education and Grand Councilor, was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，度守司徒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei, Du was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the sixth month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，度為司徒。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu, Du was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the ninth month, Pei Du was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，申錫罷為太子右庶子。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi, Shenxi was removed and made Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the third month, Shenxi was removed and appointed Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，僧孺為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day yichou, Sengru became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Sengru became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 832 六年壬子

translations.literal: 832 CE, sixth year, renzi year.
translations.idiomatic: 832 CE, sixth year, renzi year.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，僧孺檢校尚書右僕射、平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yichou, Sengru was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the twelfth month, Sengru was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 833 七年癸丑

translations.literal: 833 CE, seventh year, guichou year.
translations.idiomatic: 833 CE, seventh year, guichou year.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，兵部尚書李德裕守本官、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu, Li Deyu, Minister of War, kept his original post and was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the second month, Li Deyu, Minister of War, kept his original post and was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，宗閔檢校禮部尚書、平章事、興元節度使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai, Zongmin was made acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the sixth month, Zongmin was appointed acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and Xingyuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，德裕為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingyou, Deyu became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the seventh month, Deyu became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，尚書右僕射、諸道鹽鐵轉運使王涯守右僕射、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day renyin, Wang Ya, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits, kept the Right Vice Directorship and was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Wang Ya, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, kept the Right Vice Directorship and was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 是年，隋為太子太師。

translations.literal: That year, Sui was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Sui was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 835 九年己卯

translations.literal: 835 CE, ninth year, jimao year.
translations.idiomatic: 835 CE, ninth year, jimao year.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申，隋檢校尚書右僕射、平章事、鎮海軍節度使。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingshen, Sui was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of the Zhenhai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the fourth month, Sui was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Zhenhai military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，浙西觀察使賈餗守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day wuxu, Jia Su, observation commissioner of Zhexi, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Jia Su, observation commissioner of Zhexi, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，宗閔貶明州刺史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renyin, Zongmin was demoted to prefect of Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the sixth month, Zongmin was demoted to prefect of Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，御史大夫李固言守門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinhai, Li Guyan, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the seventh month, Li Guyan, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，固言檢校兵部尚書、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao, Guyan was made acting Minister of War and military commissioner of Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the ninth month, Guyan was appointed acting Minister of War and military commissioner of Shannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 己巳，御史中丞舒元輿為刑部侍郎，兵部侍郎、翰林學士李訓為禮部侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jisi, Censor-in-Chief Shu Yuanyu was made Vice Minister of Justice; Li Xun, Vice Minister of Rites and Hanlin Academician, was made Vice Minister of Rites; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Shu Yuanyu, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Minister of Justice, and Li Xun, Vice Minister of Rites and Hanlin Academician, Vice Minister of Rites; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月乙亥，涯兼諸道鹽鐵榷茶使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day yihai, Ya also held the post of Commissioner for Salt, Iron, and Tea Monopoly in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the tenth month, Ya also held the post of Commissioner for Salt, Iron, and Tea Monopoly in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 庚子，度兼中書令。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, Du also held the post of Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Pei Du also held the post of Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，訓斬首於昆明池。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi, Xun was beheaded at Kunming Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the eleventh month, Li Xun was beheaded at Kunming Pool.

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射鄭覃同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zheng Tan, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tan, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，元輿、餗為仇士良所殺。

translations.literal: Day yichou, Yuanyu and Su were killed by Qiu Shiliang.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Yuanyu and Su were killed by the eunuch Qiu Shiliang.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎、判度支李石守本官、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Li Shi, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, kept his original post and was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, kept his original post and was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉，智興卒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day guiyou, Zhixing died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the seventh month, Zhixing died.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，載義守太傅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou, Zaiyi was appointed Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the eleventh month, Zaiyi was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，涯為司空。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei, Ya was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fifth month, Ya was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，仇士良殺涯。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou, Qiu Shiliang killed Ya.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the eleventh month, the eunuch Qiu Shiliang killed Wang Ya.

sentences.zh: 正月甲子，覃兼門下侍郎，石為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: First month, day jiazi, Tan also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery; Shi became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the first month, Tan also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery, and Shi became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月甲午，李固言守門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，石兼鹽鐵使。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiawu, Li Guyan was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Shi also held the salt and iron commissionership.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fourth month, Li Guyan was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Shi also held the salt and iron commissionership.

sentences.zh: 丙申，固言判戶部。

translations.literal: Day bingshen, Guyan took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Guyan took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，罷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi, he was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fifth month, he was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，覃兼國子祭酒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou, Tan also held the post of Chancellor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Tan also held the post of Chancellor of the National University.

sentences.zh: 石罷度支。

translations.literal: Shi ceased acting as controller of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Shi ceased serving as acting controller of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 837 二年丁巳

translations.literal: 837 CE, second year, dingsi year.
translations.idiomatic: 837 CE, second year, dingsi year.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌，翰林學士、工部侍郎陳夷行以本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuxu, Chen Yixing, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fourth month, Chen Yixing, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Works, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申，固言為門下侍郎、同平章事、西川節度使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wushen, Guyan was made Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the tenth month, Guyan was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and Xichuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，石罷鹽鐵使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renxu, Shi ceased serving as salt and iron commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the eleventh month, Shi ceased serving as salt and iron commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，載義卒。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengshen, Zaiyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the fourth month, Zaiyi died.

sentences.zh: 正月戊辰，戶部尚書、諸道鹽鐵轉運使楊嗣復，戶部侍郎、判戶部李玨，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, day wuchen, Yang Sifu, Minister of Revenue and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits, and Li Jue, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, were both made Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the first month, Yang Sifu, Minister of Revenue and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, and Li Jue, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, were both appointed Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙子，石以中書侍郎同中書門下平章事、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, Shi was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery as Vice Director of the Secretariat and military commissioner of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Shi was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery as Vice Director of the Secretariat and military commissioner of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，覃為太子太師。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu, Tan was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the third month, Tan was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申，玨罷戶部。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingshen, Jue ceased acting as controller of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the fourth month, Jue ceased serving as acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 七月戊辰，嗣復罷鹽鐵使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day wuchen, Sifu ceased serving as salt and iron commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the seventh month, Sifu ceased serving as salt and iron commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，夷行為門下侍郎，玨、嗣復為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi, Yixing became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Jue and Sifu became Vice Directors of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the ninth month, Yixing became Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Jue and Sifu Vice Directors of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，度守司徒兼中書令。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou, Du was appointed Minister of Education and Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the twelfth month, Pei Du was appointed Minister of Education and Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙午，覃罷太子太師，五日一入中書。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, Tan ceased serving as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and entered the Secretariat once every five days.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Tan ceased serving as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and entered the Secretariat once every five days.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，載義卒。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengshen, Zaiyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the fourth month, Zaiyi died.

sentences.zh: 閏正月己亥，度來朝。

translations.literal: Intercalary first month, day jihai, Du came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the intercalary first month, Pei Du came to court.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，覃罷為尚書左僕射，夷行罷為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen, Tan was removed and made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yixing was removed and made Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the fifth month, Tan was removed and appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Yixing was removed and appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 七月甲辰，太常卿崔鄲同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiachen, Cui Ying, Minister of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the seventh month, Cui Ying, Minister of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，嗣復為門下侍郎，鄲為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu, Sifu became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Ying became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eleventh month, Sifu became Vice Director of the Chancellery and Ying Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，度薨。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingxu, Du died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the third month, Pei Du died.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，玨兼戶部尚書，嗣復兼吏部尚書，鄲兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day guichou, Jue also held the Ministry of Revenue; Sifu also held the Ministry of Personnel; Ying also held the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the second month, Jue also held the Ministry of Revenue, Sifu the Ministry of Personnel, and Ying the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，玨為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jimao, Jue became Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fifth month, Jue became Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 嗣復罷，守吏部尚書、刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Sifu was removed; he was appointed Minister of Personnel and Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu was removed from office and appointed Minister of Personnel and Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 諸道鹽鐵轉運使、刑部尚書崔珙同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Yan, Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and Minister of Justice, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yan, transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits and Minister of Justice, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，玨貶太常卿。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu, Jue was demoted to Minister of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the eighth month, Jue was demoted to Minister of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，淮南節度副大使、檢校右僕射李德裕為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingchou, Li Deyu, deputy military commissioner of Huainan and acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the ninth month, Li Deyu, deputy military commissioner of Huainan and acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，珙為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, Yan became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Yan became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 841 會昌元年辛酉

translations.literal: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign, xinyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign, xinyou year.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，御史大夫陳夷行為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiaxu, Chen Yixing was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the third month, Chen Yixing was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，鄲檢校吏部尚書、同平章事、劍南西川節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guihai, Ying was made acting Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Jiannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eleventh month, Cui Ying was appointed acting Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and Jiannan West military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 842 二年壬戌

translations.literal: 842 CE, second year, renxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 842 CE, second year, renxu year.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥，夷行為尚書左僕射，珙為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, Yixing was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month, Yixing was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Yan Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，檢校尚書右僕射、淮南節度使李紳為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingchou, Li Shen, acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and military commissioner of Huainan, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the second month, Li Shen, acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Huainan military commissioner, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，紳權判度支。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen, Shen took acting charge of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the third month, Shen took acting charge of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 六月，夷行罷為太子太保。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Yixing was removed and made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Yixing was removed and appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 七月，尚書左丞兼御史中丞李讓夷為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Li Rangyi, Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Li Rangyi, Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥，李德裕為司空。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, Li Deyu was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month, Li Deyu was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，珙罷守尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinwei, Yan ceased holding the Right Vice Directorship of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the second month, Yan ceased holding the Right Vice Directorship of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，紳為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin, Shen became Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the fifth month, Shen became Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊申，翰林學士承旨、中書舍人崔鉉為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day wushen, Cui Xuan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Drafting Officer of the Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Cui Xuan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Drafting Officer of the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，紳為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Day gengxu, Shen was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Shen was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，德裕為司徒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinyou, Deyu was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the sixth month, Deyu was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 閏七月壬戌，淮南節度使、檢校尚書右僕射、駙馬都尉杜悰為尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事、諸道鹽鐵轉運使，紳檢校尚書右僕射、同平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day renxu, Du Cong, military commissioner of Huainan, acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law Office, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits; Shen was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the intercalary seventh month, Du Cong, Huainan military commissioner, acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law Office, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits; Shen was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，讓夷為檢校尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎，鉉兼戶部尚書，悰為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu, Rangyi was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Secretariat; Xuan also held the Ministry of Revenue; Cong was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the eighth month, Rangyi was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Secretariat; Xuan also held the Ministry of Revenue; and Cong was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，德裕守太尉。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wushen, Deyu was appointed Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the eighth month, Deyu was appointed Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 正月己未，德裕加特進。

translations.literal: First month, day jiwei, Deyu was given the special advancement rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the first month, Deyu was given the special advancement rank.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，鉉罷為戶部尚書，悰罷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu, Xuan was removed and made Minister of Revenue; Cong was removed and made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the fifth month, Xuan was removed and appointed Minister of Revenue, and Cong was removed and appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，戶部侍郎判戶部李回為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，兼判戶部。

translations.literal: Day yichou, Li Hui, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and also took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Li Hui, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while also taking charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 七月，山南東道節度使、檢校尚書右僕射鄭肅本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Zheng Su, military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit and acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Zheng Su, Shannan East military commissioner and acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 846 六年丙寅

translations.literal: 846 CE, sixth year, bingyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 846 CE, sixth year, bingyin year.

sentences.zh: 四月丙子，德裕檢校司徒、同平章事、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingzi, Deyu was made acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the fourth month, Deyu was appointed acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor, and Jingnan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，肅檢校尚書左僕射兼中書侍郎，讓夷為司空兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, Su was made acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Secretariat; Rangyi was made Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Su was appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Rangyi Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎白敏中本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi, Bai Minzhong, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fifth month, Bai Minzhong, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 九月，肅本檢校官、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Su kept his acting posts and became military commissioner of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Su kept his acting posts and became Jingnan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎、判度支盧商為中書侍郎兼工部尚書、同中書門下平章事，回為門下侍郎，敏中為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Lu Shang, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Hui became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Minzhong became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Shang, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Works, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Hui became Vice Director of the Chancellery; and Minzhong Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯，讓夷為司空。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinmao, Rangyi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fourth month, Rangyi was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 七月，讓夷檢校司空、同平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Rangyi was made acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Rangyi was appointed acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月，商檢校兵部尚書、武昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, Shang was made acting Minister of War and military commissioner of the Wuchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Shang was appointed acting Minister of War and Wuchang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書、判度支崔元式為門下侍郎兼刑部尚書，翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎韋琮為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Yuanshi, Minister of Justice and acting controller of the treasury, was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Justice; Wei Cong, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuanshi, Minister of Justice and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Justice; Wei Cong, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, Vice Director of the Secretariat; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，回檢校吏部尚書、同平章事、劍南西川節度使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingshen, Hui was made acting Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Jiannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the eighth month, Hui was appointed acting Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and Jiannan West military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯，讓夷為司空。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinmao, Rangyi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the fourth month, Rangyi was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 七月，讓夷檢校司空、同平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Rangyi was made acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Rangyi was appointed acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 正月丙寅，敏中兼刑部尚書，元式兼戶部尚書，琮兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: First month, day bingyin, Minzhong also held the Ministry of Justice; Yuanshi also held the Ministry of Revenue; Cong also held the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the first month, Minzhong also held the Ministry of Justice, Yuanshi the Ministry of Revenue, and Cong the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 己卯，邢部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使馬植同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jimao, Ma Zhi, Vice Minister of Justice and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Ma Zhi, Vice Minister of Justice and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 元式罷為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Yuanshi was removed and made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshi was removed and appointed Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎、判度支周墀同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zhou Chi, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Chi, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，敏中、琮為門下侍郎，植、墀為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu, Minzhong and Cong became Vice Directors of the Chancellery; Zhi and Chi became Vice Directors of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the sixth month, Minzhong and Cong became Vice Directors of the Chancellery, and Zhi and Chi Vice Directors of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，琮罷為太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu, Cong was removed and made Guest of the Heir Apparent, assigned to nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the eleventh month, Cong was removed and appointed Guest of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 849 三年己巳

translations.literal: 849 CE, third year, jisi year.
translations.idiomatic: 849 CE, third year, jisi year.

sentences.zh: 三月，墀兼刑部尚書，敏中為尚書右僕射，植檢校禮部尚書、天平軍節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, Chi also held the Ministry of Justice; Minzhong was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhi was made acting Minister of Rites and military commissioner of the Tianping Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Chi also held the Ministry of Justice; Minzhong was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; and Zhi acting Minister of Rites and Tianping military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月乙酉，御史大夫崔鉉守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，墀檢校刑部尚書、東川節度使，兵部侍郎、判戶部事魏扶守本官、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yiyou, Cui Xuan, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Chi was made acting Minister of Justice and Dongchuan military commissioner; Wei Fu, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, kept his original post and was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fourth month, Cui Xuan, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Chi was made acting Minister of Justice and Dongchuan military commissioner; and Wei Fu, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, kept his original post and was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 850 四年庚午

translations.literal: 850 CE, fourth year, gengwu year.
translations.idiomatic: 850 CE, fourth year, gengwu year.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，扶薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen, Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the sixth month, Fu died.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎、判度支崔龜從守戶部尚書、同中書門下平章事，判如故。

translations.literal: Cui Guicong, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, with his acting charge unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Guicong, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, with his acting charge unchanged.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，罷判。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu, he ceased acting charge.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the eighth month, he ceased acting charge.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未，翰林學士承旨兵部侍郎令狐綯守本官、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinwei, Linghu Tao, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, kept his original post and was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the tenth month, Linghu Tao, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, kept his original post and was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 851 五年辛未

translations.literal: 851 CE, fifth year, xinwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 851 CE, fifth year, xinwei year.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，敏中為特進，守司空兼門下侍郎、同平章事，招討南山、平夏党項行營兵馬都統制置使，並南北路供軍使兼邠寧慶等州節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen, Minzhong was given special advancement, appointed Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor, Pacification Commissioner for the Southern Mountains campaign and the Pingxia Tangut campaign headquarters, and supply commissioner for the northern and southern routes, and also military commissioner of Bin, Ning, Qing, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the third month, Minzhong was given special advancement and appointed Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, Pacification Commissioner for the Southern Mountains campaign and the Pingxia Tangut campaign headquarters, supply commissioner for the northern and southern routes, and military commissioner of Bin, Ning, Qing, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 四月乙卯，鉉守尚書右僕射兼門下侍郎，龜從為中書侍郎兼吏部尚書，綯為中書侍郎兼禮 部尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yimao, Xuan was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Guicong became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Personnel; Tao became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fourth month, Xuan was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Guicong became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Personnel; and Tao Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十月戊辰，戶部侍郎判戶部魏謨守本官、同中書門下平章事，判如故。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuchen, Wei Mo, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, kept his original post and was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, with his acting charge unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the tenth month, Wei Mo, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, kept his original post and was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, with his acting charge unchanged.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，龜從檢校吏部尚書，同平章事、宣武節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin, Guicong was made acting Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of the Xuanwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the eleventh month, Guicong was appointed acting Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and Xuanwu military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，敏中守司空。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen, Minzhong was appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the third month, Minzhong was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十月，敏中守司空、同中書門下平章事，兼邠寧慶等州節度使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Minzhong was appointed Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and also military commissioner of Bin, Ning, Qing, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Minzhong was appointed Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and also military commissioner of Bin, Ning, Qing, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 正月癸巳，綯兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: First month, day guisi, Tao also held the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the first month, Tao also held the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八月，禮部尚書、諸道鹽鐵轉運使裴休本官同中書門下平章事，使如故。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Pei Xiu, Minister of Rites and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post, with his commissionership unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Pei Xiu, Minister of Rites and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post and commissionership.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，謨為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu, Mo became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the twelfth month, Mo became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月甲辰，敏中檢校司徒、平章事、西川節度使。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiachen, Minzhong was made acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the fourth month, Minzhong was appointed acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor, and Xichuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 853 七年癸酉

translations.literal: 853 CE, seventh year, guiyou year.
translations.idiomatic: 853 CE, seventh year, guiyou year.

sentences.zh: 854 八年甲戌

translations.literal: 854 CE, eighth year, jiaxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 854 CE, eighth year, jiaxu year.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，休罷使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiyou, Xiu ceased serving as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the eleventh month, Xiu ceased serving as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，謨罷戶部。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi, Mo ceased acting as controller of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the twelfth month, Mo ceased acting as controller of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 855 九年乙亥

translations.literal: 855 CE, ninth year, yihai year.
translations.idiomatic: 855 CE, ninth year, yihai year.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，鉉為尚書左僕射，綯為門下侍郎，謨兼禮部尚書，休為中書侍郎兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu, Xuan was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Tao became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Mo also held the Ministry of Rites; Xiu became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the second month, Xuan was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Tao became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Mo also held the Ministry of Rites; and Xiu Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 七月丙辰，鉉檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingchen, Xuan was made acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the seventh month, Xuan was appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 856 十年丙子

translations.literal: 856 CE, tenth year, bingzi year.
translations.idiomatic: 856 CE, tenth year, bingzi year.

sentences.zh: 正月丁巳，御史大夫鄭朗守工部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, day dingsi, Zheng Lang, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the first month, Zheng Lang, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月戊子，休為檢校戶部尚書、同平章事、宣武節度使，綯為尚書右僕射，謨為門下侍郎兼戶部尚書，朗為中書侍郎兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuzi, Xiu was made acting Minister of Revenue, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of the Xuanwu Army; Tao was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Mo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue; Lang became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the tenth month, Xiu was appointed acting Minister of Revenue, Grand Councilor, and Xuanwu military commissioner; Tao Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Mo Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue; and Lang Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，戶部侍郎判戶部事崔慎由為工部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen, Cui Shenyou, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the twelfth month, Cui Shenyou, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 857 十一年丁丑

translations.literal: 857 CE, eleventh year, dingchou year.
translations.idiomatic: 857 CE, eleventh year, dingchou year.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，謨為檢校戶部尚書、平章事、西川節度使。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinsi, Mo was made acting Minister of Revenue, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the second month, Mo was appointed acting Minister of Revenue, Grand Councilor, and Xichuan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子，兵部侍郎、判度支蕭鄴本官同中書門下平章事，判如故。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengzi, Xiao Ye, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post, with his acting charge unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the seventh month, Xiao Ye, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post and acting charge.

sentences.zh: 十月，鄴罷度支。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Ye ceased acting as controller of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Ye ceased serving as acting controller of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 壬申，朗罷為檢校尚書右僕射、兼太子少師。

translations.literal: Day renshen, Lang was removed and made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Lang was removed and appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，慎由為中書侍郎、禮部尚書，鄴為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei, Shenyou became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Rites; Ye became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the eleventh month, Shenyou became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Rites, and Ye Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 858 十二年戊寅

translations.literal: 858 CE, twelfth year, wuyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 858 CE, twelfth year, wuyin year.

sentences.zh: 正月戊戌，戶部侍郎、判度支劉瑑本官同中書門下平章事，判如故。

translations.literal: First month, day wuxu, Liu Zuan, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post, with his acting charge unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the first month, Liu Zuan, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post and acting charge.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，慎由罷為檢校禮部尚書、劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: Second month, day renshen, Shenyou was removed and made acting Minister of Rites and military commissioner of Jiannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the second month, Shenyou was removed and appointed acting Minister of Rites and Jiannan East military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月戊申，兵部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使夏侯孜本官同中書門下平章事，使如故。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wushen, Xiahou Zi, Vice Minister of War and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post, with his commissionership unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the fourth month, Xiahou Zi, Vice Minister of War and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post and commissionership.

sentences.zh: 己酉，鄴為中書侍郎兼禮部尚書，瑑為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, Ye became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites; Zuan became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Ye became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites, and Zuan Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，瑑薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin, Zuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the fifth month, Zuan died.

sentences.zh: 十月癸巳，孜為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guisi, Zi became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the tenth month, Zi became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，綯為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei, Tao was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the eleventh month, Tao was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，兵部侍郎、判戶部蔣伸本官同中書門下平章事，判如故。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiayin, Jiang Shen, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post, with his acting charge unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the twelfth month, Jiang Shen, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post and acting charge.

sentences.zh: 859 十三年己卯

translations.literal: 859 CE, thirteenth year, jimao year.
translations.idiomatic: 859 CE, thirteenth year, jimao year.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，伸罷戶部。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiaxu, Shen ceased acting as controller of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the third month, Shen ceased acting as controller of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，鄴為門下侍郎，伸為中書侍郎，並兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao, Ye became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Shen became Vice Director of the Secretariat; both also held the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the eighth month, Ye became Vice Director of the Chancellery and Shen Vice Director of the Secretariat; both also held the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 孜為中書侍郎兼刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Zi became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Zi became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，鄴檢校尚書右僕射、同平章事、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu, Ye was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the eleventh month, Ye was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Jingnan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎杜審權本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen, Du Shenquan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the twelfth month, Du Shenquan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，敏中守司徒兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, Minzhong was appointed Minister of Education and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Minzhong was appointed Minister of Education, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，綯為司空。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao, Tao was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the eighth month, Tao was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，檢校司徒兼太子太師、同平章事、荊南節度使白敏中守司徒，綯為檢校司徒、同平章事、河中節度使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou, Bai Minzhong, acting Minister of Education, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Grand Councilor, and Jingnan military commissioner, was appointed Minister of Education; Tao was made acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Bai Minzhong, acting Minister of Education, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Grand Councilor, and Jingnan military commissioner, was appointed Minister of Education; Tao was made acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor, and Hezhong military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，孜為門下侍郎兼兵部尚書，伸兼刑部尚書，審權為中書侍郎兼工部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou, Zi became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of War; Shen also held the Ministry of Justice; Shenquan became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the ninth month, Zi became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of War; Shen also held the Ministry of Justice; and Shenquan Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 戊申，敏中為中書令。

translations.literal: Day wushen, Minzhong became Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Minzhong became Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十月己亥，孜為檢校尚書右僕射、同平章事、劍南西川節度使，戶部尚書，判度支畢諴為禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jihai, Zi was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and military commissioner of Jiannan West Circuit; Bi Dan, Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was made Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the tenth month, Zi was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Jiannan West military commissioner; Bi Dan, Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，福王綰為司空。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai, Prince of Fu Wan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, the Prince of Fu, Wan, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月，尚書左僕射、判度支杜悰本官兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，判如故。

translations.literal: Second month, Du Cong, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and acting controller of the treasury, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post and also Vice Director of the Chancellery, with his acting charge unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Du Cong, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and Vice Director of the Chancellery while keeping his original post and acting charge.

translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the second month, Minzhong was transferred.

translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Fu, Wan, died.

translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the first month, Shen was appointed acting Minister of War, Grand Councilor, and Hezhong military commissioner.

translations.literal: Second month, day gengzi, Shenquan became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel; Dan became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the second month, Shenquan became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel, and Dan Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of War.

translations.literal: Seventh month, Xiahou Zi was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Xiahou Zi was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the second month, Cong was appointed Minister of Works.

translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the tenth month, Cong was made Minister of Education.

translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the fourth month, Dan was removed and appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎楊收守本官、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi, Yang Shou, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, kept his original post and was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fifth month, Yang Shou, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, kept his original post and was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Shenquan was appointed acting Minister of Personnel, Grand Councilor, and Zhenhai military commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, Cao Que, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post; Cong was made acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor, and Fengxiang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十月，收為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Shou became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Shou became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the first month, the Prince of Fu, Hong, was appointed Minister of Works.

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai, Que became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the third month, Que became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月，兵部侍郎、判戶部蕭寘本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Xiao Zhi, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Xiao Zhi, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，伸為太子少保，分司東都。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu, Shen was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and assigned to nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fifth month, Shen was appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，收為門下侍郎兼刑部尚書，確兼工部尚書，寘為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao, Shou became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Justice; Que also held the Ministry of Works; Zhi became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the eighth month, Shou became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Justice; Que also held the Ministry of Works; and Zhi Vice Director of the Secretariat.

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renyin, Lu Yan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, Lu Yan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，孜為司空。

translations.idiomatic: 868 CE, ninth year, wuzi year.

translations.idiomatic: 869 CE, tenth year, jichou year.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Liu Ye, Vice Minister of War and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, was appointed Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, with his commissionership unchanged.

translations.literal: Duo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Duo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 872 十三年壬辰

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengchen, Ye also held the Ministry of Revenue; soon he became Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the eleventh month, Ye also held the Ministry of Revenue; soon he became Vice Director of the Chancellery.

translations.literal: Yin became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yin became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Baoheng was made Minister of Works; Duo was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Baoheng was made Minister of Works and Duo Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 六月，鐸檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事、宣武軍節度使。

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Duo was appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Xuanwu military commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the eighth month, Ye also held the Ministry of Personnel and Yin the Ministry of Rites.

translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the tenth month, Ye was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yin also held the Ministry of Revenue.

translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the second month, Yin was appointed acting Minister of War and Zhenhai military commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: Pei Tan, acting Minister of Revenue and concurrent Hua Prefecture prefect, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhan, Minister of Justice, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the eighth month, Zhan died.

translations.literal: Cui Yan Zhao, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yan Zhao, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the tenth month, Ye was appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎鄭畋為兵部侍郎，翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎盧攜，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.idiomatic: Zheng Tian, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Minister of War; Lu Xi, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
