sentences.zh: 六月，吏部尚書李蔚為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Li Wei, Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Li Wei, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 彥昭為尚書右僕射兼門下侍郎，畋為門下侍郎，攜兼工部尚書。

translations.literal: Yan Zhao was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Tian became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Xi also held the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhao was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Tian became Vice Director of the Chancellery; and Xi also held the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 五月，倣薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Fang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Fang died.

sentences.zh: 876 三年丙申

translations.literal: 876 CE, third year, bingshen year.
translations.idiomatic: 876 CE, third year, bingshen year.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，撫王紘為太尉，未幾，紘薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yichou, the Prince of Fu, Hong, was made Grand Preceptor; before long Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the sixth month, the Prince of Fu, Hong, was appointed Grand Preceptor; before long he died.

sentences.zh: 正月，畋兼兵部尚書，攜兼刑部尚書。

translations.literal: First month, Tian also held the Ministry of War; Xi also held the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Tian also held the Ministry of War and Xi the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 閏二月，彥昭罷為太子太傅。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, Yan Zhao was removed and made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, Yan Zhao was removed and appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 王鐸檢校司徒兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Duo was made acting Minister of Education and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Duo was appointed acting Minister of Education, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月，攜兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Xi also held the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Xi also held the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 正月丁丑，彥昭為司空。

translations.literal: First month, day dingchou, Yan Zhao was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the first month, Yan Zhao was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，鐸為司徒。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou, Duo was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the sixth month, Duo was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，畋、攜並罷為太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingyou, Tian and Xi were both removed and made Guests of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the fifth month, Tian and Xi were both removed and appointed Guests of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨、戶部侍郎豆盧瑑為兵部侍郎，吏部侍郎崔沆為戶部侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Doulu Zhuan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War; Cui Hang, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Doulu Zhuan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed Vice Minister of War; Cui Hang, Vice Minister of Personnel, Vice Minister of Revenue; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月，吏部尚書鄭從讜為中書侍郎兼禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Zheng Congdang, Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Zheng Congdang, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Rites, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 蔚檢校司空，判東都尚書省，都畿汝防禦使。

translations.literal: Wei was made acting Minister of Works, controller of the Eastern Capital Department of State Affairs, and defense commissioner of the Capital Region and Ru and Fang circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was appointed acting Minister of Works, controller of the Eastern Capital Department of State Affairs, and defense commissioner of the Capital Region and Ru and Fang circuits.

sentences.zh: 879 六年己亥

translations.literal: 879 CE, sixth year, jihai year.
translations.idiomatic: 879 CE, sixth year, jihai year.

sentences.zh: 四月，鐸檢校司空兼侍中、荊南節度使、南面行營招討都統，從讜兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Duo was made acting Minister of Works and Palace Attendant and military commissioner of Jingnan, Pacification Commissioner for the Southern Campaign Headquarters, and Congdang also held the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Duo was appointed acting Minister of Works and Palace Attendant, Jingnan military commissioner, and Pacification Commissioner for the Southern Campaign Headquarters; Congdang also held the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十二月，兵部尚書盧攜為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，瑑為中書侍郎兼戶部尚書，沆為中書侍郎兼工部尚書，從讜為門下侍郎兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Lu Xi, Minister of War, was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Zhuan became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue; Hang became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Works; Congdang became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Lu Xi, Minister of War, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Zhuan Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue; Hang Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Works; and Congdang Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 鐸貶太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: Duo was demoted to Guest of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Duo was demoted to Guest of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 880 廣明元年庚子

translations.literal: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign, gengzi year.
translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign, gengzi year.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，從讜檢校司空兼平章事、河東節度行營招討等使。

translations.literal: Second month, day renzi, Congdang was made acting Minister of Works and Grand Councilor and Hedong campaign Pacification Commissioner and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the second month, Congdang was appointed acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, and Hedong campaign Pacification Commissioner and related posts.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，攜兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu, Xi also held the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the sixth month, Xi also held the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，攜貶為太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen, Xi was demoted to Guest of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the twelfth month, Xi was demoted to Guest of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨、尚書左丞王徽為戶部侍郎，翰林學士、戶部侍郎裴澈為工部侍郎、並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Hui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Pei Che, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of Works; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hui, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue; Pei Che, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Revenue, Vice Minister of Works; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚子，黃巢殺瑑、沆。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, Huang Chao killed Zhuan and Hang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Huang Chao killed Zhuan and Hang.

sentences.zh: 八月，榮王琬守司空，是月，琬薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the Prince of Glory, Wan, was appointed Minister of Works; that month Wan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, the Prince of Glory, Wan, was appointed Minister of Works; that month he died.

sentences.zh: 881 中和元年辛丑

translations.literal: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign, xinchou year.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign, xinchou year.

sentences.zh: 正月壬申，兵部侍郎、判度支蕭遘為工部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, day renshen, Xiao Zou, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was made Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day of the first month, Xiao Zou, Vice Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月，澈兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, Che also held the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Che also held the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太子少師王鐸為司徒兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jimao, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Duo was made Minister of Education and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Duo was appointed Minister of Education, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月，徽罷為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Third month, Hui was removed and made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Hui was removed and appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，澈為門下侍郎兼兵部尚書，遘為中書侍郎兼禮部尚書，鐸兼侍中。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuyin, Che became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of War; Zou became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites; Duo also held the post of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fourth month, Che became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of War; Zou Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites; and Duo also held the post of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，檢校司空、同平章事、京城西面行營都統鄭畋守司空兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、京城四面行營都統，鐸守司徒兼太子太保。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuxu, Zheng Tian, acting Minister of Works and Grand Councilor and commander of the western capital campaign headquarters, was appointed Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor and commander of the capital-region campaign headquarters; Duo was appointed Minister of Education and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the sixth month, Zheng Tian, acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, and commander of the western capital campaign headquarters, was appointed Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and commander of the capital-region campaign headquarters; Duo Minister of Education and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 七月庚申，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎韋昭度本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengshen, Wei Zhaodu, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the seventh month, Wei Zhaodu, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 十一月，畋罷為太子少傅，分司東都。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Tian was removed and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Tian was removed and appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 澈為檢校兵部尚書、鄂岳觀察使，遘兼戶部尚書，昭度為中書侍郎兼禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Che was made acting Minister of War and Eyué observation commissioner; Zou also held the Ministry of Revenue; Zhaodu became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Che was appointed acting Minister of War and Eyué observation commissioner; Zou also held the Ministry of Revenue; and Zhaodu Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，鐸為司徒，駢為太尉。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao, Duo was made Minister of Education; Pian was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the second month, Duo was made Minister of Education and Pian Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，鐸守司徒，畋為司空。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingchou, Duo was appointed Minister of Education; Tian was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the sixth month, Duo was appointed Minister of Education and Tian was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十一月，畋為太子少傅，分司東都。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Tian was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Tian was appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 正月辛亥，鐸為諸道行營都都統，兼指揮諸軍兵馬收復京城及諸道租庸等使，權知義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: First month, day xinhai, Duo was made supreme commander of all campaign headquarters, concurrently commissioner for recovering the capital and collecting rent and corvée levies in all circuits, and acting military commissioner of the Yicheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the first month, Duo was made supreme commander of all campaign headquarters, concurrently commissioner for recovering the capital and collecting rent and corvée levies in all circuits, and acting military commissioner of the Yicheng Army.

sentences.zh: 二月，遘判度支，鐸兼判戶部。

translations.literal: Second month, Zou took charge of the treasury; Duo also took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zou took charge of the treasury and Duo also took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 己卯，鄭畋為司空兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jimao, Zheng Tian was made Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Zheng Tian was appointed Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月，遘為門下侍郎兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Zou became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zou became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 五月，昭度兼吏部尚書，遘為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Zhaodu also held the Ministry of Personnel; Zou was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Zhaodu also held the Ministry of Personnel and Zou was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，畋為司空。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao, Tian was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the second month, Tian was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 正月乙亥，鐸檢校司徒兼中書令、義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: First month, day yihai, Duo was made acting Minister of Education and Director of the Secretariat and military commissioner of the Yicheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the first month, Duo was appointed acting Minister of Education and Director of the Secretariat and Yicheng military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月，東都留守、檢校司空兼侍中鄭從讜為司空，兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Zheng Congdang, Eastern Capital intendant, acting Minister of Works, and Palace Attendant, was made Minister of Works and also Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Zheng Congdang, Eastern Capital intendant, acting Minister of Works, and Palace Attendant, was appointed Minister of Works and also Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月，昭度為門下侍郎，檢校兵部尚書、判度支裴澈為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Zhaodu became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Pei Che, acting Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Zhaodu became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Pei Che, acting Minister of War and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月，建王震守太保。

translations.literal: Second month, the Prince of Jian, Zhen, was appointed Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Prince of Jian, Zhen, was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 五月，畋為司徒，從讜為司空。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Tian was made Minister of Education; Congdang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Tian was made Minister of Education and Congdang Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 七月，畋罷為檢校司徒，守太子太保。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Tian was removed and made acting Minister of Education and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Tian was removed and appointed acting Minister of Education and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十月，澈加尚書右僕射，昭度加左僕射，並兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Che was given the additional post of Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhaodu was given the Left Vice Directorship; both also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Che was given the additional post of Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Zhaodu the Left Vice Directorship; both also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月，建王震守太保。

translations.literal: Second month, the Prince of Jian, Zhen, was appointed Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the Prince of Jian, Zhen, was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 十月，遘為司空。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Zou was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zou was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三月，澈為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Third month, Che was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Che was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月，遘為司徒，昭度為司空。

translations.literal: Second month, Zou was made Minister of Education; Zhaodu was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zou was made Minister of Education and Zhaodu Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，御史大夫孔緯，翰林學士承旨、兵部尚書杜讓能，並為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuxu, Censor-in-Chief Kong Wei and Du Rangneng, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Minister of War, were both made Vice Ministers of War and Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the third month, Kong Wei, Censor-in-Chief, and Du Rangneng, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Minister of War, were both appointed Vice Ministers of War and Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月，緯為中書侍郎，讓能為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Wei became Vice Director of the Secretariat; Rangneng became Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Wei became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Rangneng Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月，從讜為太傅兼侍中。

translations.literal: Second month, Congdang was made Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Congdang was appointed Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 887 三年丁未

translations.literal: 887 CE, third year, dingwei year.
translations.idiomatic: 887 CE, third year, dingwei year.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，澈伏誅。

translations.literal: Third month, day guiwei, Che was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the third month, Che was executed.

sentences.zh: 緯為門下侍郎，讓能為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Wei became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Rangneng became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wei became Vice Director of the Chancellery and Rangneng Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 六月，緯兼吏部尚書，充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Wei also held the Ministry of Personnel and served as Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Wei also held the Ministry of Personnel and served as commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits and related posts.

sentences.zh: 讓能兼兵部尚書，昭度兼侍中。

translations.literal: Rangneng also held the Ministry of War; Zhaodu also held the post of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Rangneng also held the Ministry of War and Zhaodu the post of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 九月，戶部侍郎、判度支張濬為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: September, Zhang Jun, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was made Vice Minister of War and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Zhang Jun, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the treasury, was appointed Vice Minister of War and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月，昭度為太保兼侍中。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Zhaodu was made Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Zhaodu was appointed Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 三月，從讜為太子太保。

translations.literal: Third month, Congdang was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Congdang was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遘伏誅。

translations.literal: Day guiwei, Zou was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Zou was executed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，昭度為司徒。

translations.literal: Day renchen, Zhaodu was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Zhaodu was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 二月，讓能為尚書右僕射，緯為左僕射，濬為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, Rangneng was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Wei was made Left Vice Director; Jun became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Rangneng was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Wei Left Vice Director; and Jun Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月，昭度守中書令，讓能為尚書左僕射，濬守戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Zhaodu was appointed Director of the Secretariat; Rangneng was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Jun was appointed Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zhaodu was appointed Director of the Secretariat; Rangneng Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; and Jun Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 六月，昭度檢校太尉兼中書令、劍南西川節度兼兩川招撫制置等使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Zhaodu was made acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat and military commissioner of Jiannan West Circuit and Pacification Commissioner for the Two Sichuan Circuits and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Zhaodu was appointed acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, Jiannan West military commissioner, and Pacification Commissioner for the Two Sichuan Circuits and related posts.

sentences.zh: 九月，緯兼國子祭酒。

translations.literal: September, Wei also held the post of Chancellor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Wei also held the post of Chancellor of the National University.

sentences.zh: 二月，昭度兼中書令。

translations.literal: Second month, Zhaodu also held the post of Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zhaodu also held the post of Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月，昭度守中書令。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Zhaodu was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Zhaodu was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月，緯為司空。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Wei was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Wei was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 正月，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎劉崇望本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, Liu Chongwang, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Liu Chongwang, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 三月，濬兼吏部尚書，崇望為中書侍郎，讓能兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Third month, Jun also held the Ministry of Personnel; Chongwang became Vice Director of the Secretariat; Rangneng also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Jun also held the Ministry of Personnel; Chongwang became Vice Director of the Secretariat; and Rangneng also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，崇望兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiyou, Chongwang also held the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eleventh month, Chongwang also held the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，緯為太保。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu, Wei was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the eleventh month, Wei was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 三月，緯為司徒，讓能為司空。

translations.literal: Third month, Wei was made Minister of Education; Rangneng was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Wei was made Minister of Education and Rangneng Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，讓能為司徒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuwu, Rangneng was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, Rangneng was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 890 大順元年庚戌

translations.literal: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign, gengxu year.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign, gengxu year.

sentences.zh: 五月，濬為河東行營都招討制置宣慰使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Jun was made Pacification and Comfort Commissioner for the Hedong campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Jun was appointed Pacification and Comfort Commissioner for the Hedong campaign headquarters.

sentences.zh: 891 二年辛亥

translations.literal: 891 CE, second year, xinhai year.
translations.idiomatic: 891 CE, second year, xinhai year.

sentences.zh: 正月庚申，緯檢校太保兼御史大夫、荊南節度使，濬罷為檢校尚書右僕射、鄂岳觀察使。

translations.literal: First month, day gengshen, Wei was made acting Grand Tutor and Censor-in-Chief and military commissioner of Jingnan; Jun was removed and made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Eyué observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the first month, Wei was appointed acting Grand Tutor and Censor-in-Chief and Jingnan military commissioner; Jun was removed and appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Eyué observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎崔昭緯，御史中丞徐彥若為戶部侍郎，並同中書門下平 章事。

translations.literal: Cui Zhaowei, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, and Xu Yanruo, Censor-in-Chief, were made Vice Ministers of Revenue; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zhaowei, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, and Xu Yanruo, Censor-in-Chief, were appointed Vice Ministers of Revenue; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 崇望判度支。

translations.literal: Chongwang took charge of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Chongwang took charge of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 二月，崇望為門下侍郎，昭緯、彥若並為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, Chongwang became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Zhaowei and Yanruo both became Vice Directors of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Chongwang became Vice Director of the Chancellery; Zhaowei and Yanruo both became Vice Directors of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十月，崇望為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Chongwang was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Chongwang was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月，昭緯兼吏部尚書，彥若兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Zhaowei also held the Ministry of Personnel; Yanruo also held the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhaowei also held the Ministry of Personnel and Yanruo the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 正月庚申，緯遷。

translations.literal: First month, day gengshen, Wei was transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the first month, Wei was transferred.

sentences.zh: 二月，崇望罷為檢校司徒、同中書門下平章事、武寧軍節度使。

translations.literal: Second month, Chongwang was removed and made acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and military commissioner of the Wuning Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Chongwang was removed and appointed acting Minister of Education, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Wuning military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三月，戶部尚書鄭延昌為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Third month, Zheng Yanchang, Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Zheng Yanchang, Minister of Revenue, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月，昭緯為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Zhaowei became Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Zhaowei became Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月，讓能守太尉。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Rangneng was appointed Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Rangneng was appointed Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 正月，彥若為檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事、鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: First month, Yanruo was made acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Fengxiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Yanruo was appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Fengxiang military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月，昭緯為尚書左僕射，延昌兼刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Zhaowei was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yanchang also held the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Zhaowei was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yanchang also held the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，檢校司徒、東都留守韋昭度為司徒兼門下侍郎，御史中丞崔胤為戶部侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: September, day renchen, Wei Zhaodu, acting Minister of Education and Eastern Capital intendant, was made Minister of Education and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Cui Yin, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the ninth month, Wei Zhaodu, acting Minister of Education and Eastern Capital intendant, was appointed Minister of Education and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Cui Yin, Censor-in-Chief, Vice Minister of Revenue; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月，昭緯充諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Zhaowei served as Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zhaowei served as commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 十二月，昭度為太傅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Zhaodu was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhaodu was appointed Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 九月，讓能貶梧州刺史，再貶雷州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: September, Rangneng was demoted to prefect of Wu Prefecture, then again to registrar of Lei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Rangneng was demoted to prefect of Wu Prefecture, then again to registrar of Lei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 昭度守司徒。

translations.literal: Zhaodu was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaodu was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 十月，讓能賜死。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Rangneng was ordered to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Rangneng was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 二月，延昌為尚書右僕射兼門下侍郎，右散騎常侍鄭綮為禮部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, Yanchang was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Zheng Qi, Regular Attendant of the Right Scattered Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Yanchang was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Zheng Qi, Regular Attendant of the Right Scattered Cavalry, Vice Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月，延昌罷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Yanchang was removed and made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yanchang was removed and appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，胤為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Yin became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Yin became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊午，翰林學士承旨、禮部尚書李磎本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, Li Xi, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Minister of Rites, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Li Xi, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Minister of Rites, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 庚申，磎罷為太子少傅。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, Xi was removed and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Xi was removed and appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫徐彥若為中書侍郎兼吏部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Xu Yanruo, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Personnel and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yanruo, Censor-in-Chief, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Personnel, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月，綮為太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Qi retired as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Qi retired as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二月，昭度守太傅。

translations.literal: Second month, Zhaodu was appointed Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Zhaodu was appointed Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 正月己巳，給事中陸希聲為戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: First month, day jisi, Lu Xisheng, Drafting Officer in the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the first month, Lu Xisheng, Drafting Officer in the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，李磎為戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事，判度支。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei, Li Xi was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the second month, Li Xi was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 三月，胤檢校尚書右僕射、同平章事、護國節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, Yin was made acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huguo military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yin was appointed acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Huguo military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 磎罷為檢校吏部尚書，守太子少師。

translations.literal: Xi was removed and made acting Minister of Personnel and Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Xi was removed and appointed acting Minister of Personnel and Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎判戶部王摶為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Bo, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo, Vice Minister of Revenue and acting controller of the Ministry of Revenue, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月，希聲罷為太子少師，昭度太保致仕。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Xisheng was removed and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Zhaodu retired as Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Xisheng was removed and appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Zhaodu retired as Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，吏部尚書孔緯為司空兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，彥若為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi, Kong Wei, Minister of Personnel, was made Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Yanruo was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the sixth month, Kong Wei, Minister of Personnel, was appointed Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Yanruo Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月庚申，京兆尹、檢校司徒兼戶部尚書、判度支、諸道鹽鐵轉運使嗣薛王知柔權知中書事及隨駕置頓使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day gengshen, Zhirou, Prince of the Succession Xue line, Jingzhao intendant, acting Minister of Education, Minister of Revenue, acting controller of the treasury, and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits, took charge of Secretariat affairs and the imperial procession logistics commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the seventh month, Zhirou, Prince of the Succession Xue line, Jingzhao intendant, acting Minister of Education, Minister of Revenue, acting controller of the treasury, and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, took charge of Secretariat affairs and served as imperial procession logistics commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，崔胤為中書侍郎兼禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, Cui Yin was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Rites and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Cui Yin was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Rites, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 辛未，知柔為清海軍節度使、同平章事，仍權知京兆尹、判度支，充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, Zhirou was made Qinghai military commissioner and Grand Councilor, and still took acting charge of Jingzhao and the treasury and served as Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Zhirou was appointed Qinghai military commissioner and Grand Councilor, and still took acting charge of Jingzhao and the treasury and served as commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits and related posts.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，昭緯罷為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi, Zhaowei was removed and made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the eighth month, Zhaowei was removed and appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 摶為門下侍郎兼戶部尚書、判度支、諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Bo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue, acting controller of the treasury, and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Bo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue, acting controller of the treasury, and transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 九月，胤判戶部。

translations.literal: September, Yin took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the September, Yin took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十月，京兆尹孫偓為戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事，判戶部。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Sun Wo, Jingzhao intendant, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Sun Wo, Jingzhao intendant, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，河東節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事李克用守太師兼中書令，充邠寧四面諸軍行營都統。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou, Li Keyong, Hedong military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor and Grand Councilor, was appointed Grand Master and Director of the Secretariat and supreme commander of the campaign forces on all sides of Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the eighth month, Li Keyong, Hedong military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor and Grand Councilor, was appointed Grand Master and Director of the Secretariat and supreme commander of the campaign forces on all sides of Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，孔緯為司空。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guisi, Kong Wei was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day of the sixth month, Kong Wei was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，彥若為司空。

translations.literal: September, day bingchen, Yanruo was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the September, Yanruo was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，緯薨。

translations.literal: Day guihai, Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Wei died.

sentences.zh: 五月，偓為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Wo was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Wo was made Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 七月乙巳，胤檢校禮部尚書、同平章事、武安軍節度使。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day yisi, Yin was made acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and Wu'an military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the seventh month, Yin was appointed acting Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor, and Wu'an military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 偓為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Wo became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wo became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙午，翰林學士承旨、尚書左丞陸扆為戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, Lu Yi, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Lu Yi, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Left Assistant in the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，摶檢校戶部尚書、同平章事、威勝軍節度使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiayin, Bo was made acting Minister of Revenue, Grand Councilor, and Weisheng military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the eighth month, Bo was appointed acting Minister of Revenue, Grand Councilor, and Weisheng military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，扆為中書侍郎判戶部。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, Yi became Vice Director of the Secretariat and took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Yi became Vice Director of the Secretariat and took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，國子監毛詩博士朱樸為左諫議大夫、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day yichou, Zhu Pu, Erudite of the Mao Odes at the National University, was made Left Remonstrance Official and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Zhu Pu, Erudite of the Mao Odes at the National University, was appointed Left Remonstrance Official and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，崔胤為中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、同中書門下平章事，翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎崔遠本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: September, day yiwei, Cui Yin was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Cui Yuan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the September, Cui Yin was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Cui Yuan, Hanlin Academician-in-Chief and Vice Minister of War, Grand Councilor while keeping his original post.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，扆貶峽州刺史。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, Yi was demoted to prefect of Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Yi was demoted to prefect of Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，樸判戶部。

translations.literal: Day jihai, Pu took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Pu took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 戊申，偓為門下侍郎兼諸道鹽鐵轉運使，判度支。

translations.literal: Day wushen, Wo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and acting controller of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Wo became Vice Director of the Chancellery, concurrent transport commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits, and acting controller of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 十月壬子，偓兼禮部尚書，持節鳳翔四面行營節度諸軍都統、招討、處置等使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renzi, Wo also held the Ministry of Rites and bore the staff of authority as supreme commander, Pacification Commissioner, and Disposal Commissioner for the Fengxiang campaign headquarters on all sides.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the tenth month, Wo also held the Ministry of Rites and bore the staff of authority as supreme commander, Pacification Commissioner, and Disposal Commissioner for the Fengxiang campaign headquarters on all sides.

sentences.zh: 戊午，王摶為吏部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, Wang Bo was made Minister of Personnel and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Wang Bo was appointed Minister of Personnel and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，樸為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao, Pu became Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the eleventh month, Pu became Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月，彥若兼侍中、大明宮留守、京畿安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Third month, Yanruo also held the post of Palace Attendant, was Daming Palace intendant, and Capital Region Pacification and Disposal Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yanruo also held the post of Palace Attendant, was Daming Palace intendant, and Capital Region Pacification and Disposal Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 正月巳亥，偓罷都統招討使。

translations.literal: First month, day jihai, Wo ceased serving as supreme commander and Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month, Wo ceased serving as supreme commander and Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，偓罷守禮部尚書，樸罷守祕書監。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai, Wo ceased holding the Ministry of Rites; Pu ceased holding the Directorate of the Imperial Library.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the second month, Wo ceased holding the Ministry of Rites and Pu ceased holding the Directorate of the Imperial Library.

sentences.zh: 三月，遠判戶部。

translations.literal: Third month, Yuan took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Yuan took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 四月，摶為門下侍郎兼吏部尚書、諸道轉運等使，遠為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Bo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel and Commissioner for Transport in all circuits and related posts; Yuan became Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Bo became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Personnel and commissioner for transport in all circuits and related posts; Yuan became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，遠為中書侍郎，胤兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yisi, Yuan became Vice Director of the Secretariat; Yin also held the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the sixth month, Yuan became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Yin also held the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 898 光化元年戊午

translations.literal: 898 CE, first year of the Guanghua reign, wuwu year.
translations.idiomatic: 898 CE, first year of the Guanghua reign, wuwu year.

sentences.zh: 正月，摶為尚書右僕射兼門下侍郎，胤兼吏部尚書，遠兼工部尚書。

translations.literal: First month, Bo was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Yin also held the Ministry of Personnel; Yuan also held the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Bo was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery; Yin also held the Ministry of Personnel; and Yuan the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月，鎮國匡國軍節度使、檢校太尉兼侍中韓建守太傅、兼中書令。

translations.literal: September, Han Jian, military commissioner of the Zhenguo and Kuangguo armies, acting Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant, was appointed Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the September, Han Jian, military commissioner of the Zhenguo and Kuangguo armies, acting Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant, was appointed Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 正月，彥若為司徒。

translations.literal: First month, Yanruo was made Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Yanruo was made Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 正月丁未，胤罷守吏部尚書。

translations.literal: First month, day dingwei, Yin ceased holding the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the first month, Yin ceased holding the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書陸扆本官同中書門下平章事，未幾，為中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事。

translations.literal: Lu Yi, Minister of War, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery in his original post; before long he became Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yi, Minister of War, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery while keeping his original post; before long he became Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Revenue, and Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 彥若兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Yanruo also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Yanruo also held the Vice Directorship of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月，彥若為太保。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Yanruo was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Yanruo was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 十一月，摶為司空。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Bo was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Bo was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 四月，遠兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Yuan also held the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Yuan also held the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，崔胤為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、諸道鹽鐵轉運等使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao, Cui Yin was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and related posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the sixth month, Cui Yin was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits and related posts.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，彥若檢校太尉、同平章事、清海軍節度使。

translations.literal: September, day yisi, Yanruo was made acting Grand Preceptor, Grand Councilor, and Qinghai military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the September, Yanruo was appointed acting Grand Preceptor, Grand Councilor, and Qinghai military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遠罷為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, Yuan was removed and made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Yuan was removed and appointed Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 戊申，刑部尚書裴贄為中書侍郎兼刑部尚書、同中書門下平章事、扆為門下侍郎兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Day wushen, Pei Zan, Minister of Justice, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent Minister of Justice and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Yi became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Pei Zan, Minister of Justice, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Minister of Justice, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Yi became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 六月，摶罷為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: Sixth month, Bo was removed and made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Bo was removed and appointed Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月，翰林學士、戶部侍郎王溥為中書侍郎，吏部侍郎裴樞為戶部侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, Wang Pu, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Pei Shu, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Wang Pu, Hanlin Academician and Vice Minister of Revenue, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat; Pei Shu, Vice Minister of Personnel, Vice Minister of Revenue; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月，扆兼兵部尚書，贄兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Yi also held the Ministry of War; Zan also held the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Yi also held the Ministry of War and Zan the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，兵部侍郎盧光啟權句當中書事，兼判三司。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou, Lu Guangqi, Vice Minister of War, took acting charge of Secretariat affairs and also took charge of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the eleventh month, Lu Guangqi, Vice Minister of War, took acting charge of Secretariat affairs and also took charge of the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，光啟為右諫議大夫，參知機務。

translations.literal: Day dingmao, Guangqi was made Right Remonstrance Official and participated in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Guangqi was appointed Right Remonstrance Official and participated in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，胤、樞罷，並守工部尚書。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, Yin and Shu were both removed and made Ministers of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Yin and Shu were both removed and appointed Ministers of Works.

sentences.zh: 正月，胤為司空。

translations.literal: First month, Yin was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Yin was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 正月丁卯，給事中韋貽範為工部侍郎、同中書門下平章事、判度支。

translations.literal: First month, day dingmao, Wei Yifan, Drafting Officer in the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the first month, Wei Yifan, Drafting Officer in the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 四月，光啟罷為太子少保。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Guangqi was removed and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Guangqi was removed and appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，貽範以母喪罷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengwu, Yifan was removed on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the fifth month, Yifan was removed on account of mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，中書舍人蘇檢為工部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingzi, Su Jian, Drafting Officer of the Secretariat, was made Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the sixth month, Su Jian, Drafting Officer of the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Minister of Works and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，貽範起復，守戶部侍郎、同中書門下平章事，依前充諸道鹽鐵轉運等使，判度支。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jihai, Yifan returned from mourning and was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, again serving as Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and related posts and taking charge of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the eighth month, Yifan returned from mourning and was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, again serving as commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits and related posts and taking charge of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，貽範薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen, Yifan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the eleventh month, Yifan died.

sentences.zh: 903 三年癸亥

translations.literal: 903 CE, third year, guihai year.
translations.idiomatic: 903 CE, third year, guihai year.

sentences.zh: 正月壬子，崔胤守司空兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，判使如故；

translations.literal: First month, day renzi, Cui Yin was appointed Minister of Works and Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, with his commissionership unchanged;
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the first month, Cui Yin was appointed Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery, with his commissionership unchanged;

sentences.zh: 辛未，兼判六軍十二衛事。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, he also took charge of the Six Armies and Twelve Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, he also took charge of the Six Armies and Twelve Guards.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，扆貶沂王傅，分司東都。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu, Yi was demoted to Tutor of the Prince of Yi and assigned to nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the second month, Yi was demoted to Tutor of the Prince of Yi and assigned to nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙子，胤兼侍中。

translations.literal: Day bingzi, Yin also held the post of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Yin also held the post of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 檢為全忠所害。

translations.literal: Jian was killed by Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Jian was killed by Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 溥罷為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Pu was removed and made Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Pu was removed and appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 乙未，清海軍節度使、檢校尚書右僕射、同平章事裴樞為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, Pei Shu, Qinghai military commissioner, acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Grand Councilor, was made Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Pei Shu, Qinghai military commissioner, acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Grand Councilor, was appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月，贄罷為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Zan was removed and made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zan was removed and appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，禮部尚書獨孤損為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day xinsi, Dugu Sun, Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of War and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Dugu Sun, Minister of Rites, was appointed Vice Minister of War and Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月庚辰，胤守司徒。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengchen, Yin was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the second month, Yin was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 宣武宣義天平護國軍節度、晉絳慈隰觀察處置安邑解縣兩池榷鹽制置等使、檢校太師兼中書令梁王朱全忠守太尉、中書令，充諸道兵馬副元帥；

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong, Prince of Liang, military commissioner of the Xuanwu, Xuanyi, Tianping, and Huguo armies, observation and disposal commissioner for Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Liao, and salt monopoly commissioner for the Anyi and Jie county pools, acting Grand Master and Director of the Secretariat, was appointed Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat and deputy supreme commander of all military forces in the circuits;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong, Prince of Liang, military commissioner of the Xuanwu, Xuanyi, Tianping, and Huguo armies, observation and disposal commissioner for Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Liao, and salt monopoly commissioner for the Anyi and Jie county pools, acting Grand Master and Director of the Secretariat, was appointed Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat and deputy supreme commander of all military forces in the circuits;

sentences.zh: 四 月己卯，判元帥府事。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jimao, he took charge of the deputy supreme commander's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day of the fourth month, he took charge of the deputy supreme commander's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，劍南東西川節度使、檢校太師王建守司徒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen, Wang Jian, military commissioner of the Two Sichuan Circuits and acting Grand Master, was appointed Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the eighth month, Wang Jian, military commissioner of the Two Sichuan Circuits and acting Grand Master, was appointed Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 正月乙巳，胤罷為太子少傅，分司東都。

translations.literal: First month, day yisi, Yin was removed and made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the first month, Yin was removed and appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with nominal duty at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書崔遠為中書侍郎，翰林學士、左拾遺柳璨為右諫議大夫，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Yuan, Minister of War, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat; Liu Can, Hanlin Academician and Left Reminder Official, was made Right Remonstrance Official; both were Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuan, Minister of War, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat; Liu Can, Hanlin Academician and Left Reminder Official, Right Remonstrance Official; both became Grand Councilors of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 樞判左三軍事、諸道鹽鐵轉運等使，損 判右三軍事、判度支。

translations.literal: Shu took charge of the Left Three Armies and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits and related posts; Sun took charge of the Right Three Armies and the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Shu took charge of the Left Three Armies and commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits and related posts; Sun the Right Three Armies and the treasury.

sentences.zh: 閏四月乙卯，損為門下侍郎兼戶部尚書，遠兼兵部尚書，樞為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day yimao, Sun became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue; Yuan also held the Ministry of War; Shu was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the intercalary fourth month, Sun became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue; Yuan also held the Ministry of War; and Shu was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，全忠兼判左右神策及六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingwei, Quanzhong also took charge of the Left and Right Divine Strategy Armies and the Six Armies and various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the third month, Quanzhong also took charge of the Left and Right Divine Strategy Armies and the Six Armies and various guards.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，樞罷為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi, Shu was removed and made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the third month, Shu was removed and appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，損檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事、靜海軍節度使，禮部侍郎張文蔚同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Day wuyin, Sun was made acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Jinghai military commissioner; Zhang Wenwei, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Sun was appointed acting Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Jinghai military commissioner; Zhang Wenwei, Vice Minister of Rites, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吏部侍郎楊涉同中書門下平章事、判戶部，文蔚為中書侍郎、判度支，璨為門下侍郎兼戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, Yang She, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the Ministry of Revenue; Wenwei became Vice Director of the Secretariat and took charge of the treasury; Can became Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Yang She, Vice Minister of Personnel, was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery and took charge of the Ministry of Revenue; Wenwei became Vice Director of the Secretariat and took charge of the treasury; and Can Vice Director of the Chancellery and concurrent Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 遠罷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Yuan was removed and made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was removed and appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，璨為司空、諸道鹽鐵轉運使；

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guimao, Can was made Minister of Works and Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport in all circuits;
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the twelfth month, Can was made Minister of Works and commissioner for salt and iron transport in all circuits;

sentences.zh: 癸丑，貶登州刺史。

translations.literal: Day guichou, he was demoted to prefect of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, he was demoted to prefect of Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，全忠進封魏王，授相國，總百揆。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinsi, Quanzhong was advanced to Prince of Wei, made Imperial Chancellor, and put in overall charge of state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the eleventh month, Quanzhong was advanced to Prince of Wei, made Imperial Chancellor, and put in overall charge of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，全忠為天下兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou, Quanzhong was made supreme commander of all military forces under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the twelfth month, Quanzhong was made supreme commander of all military forces under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，璨為司空。

translations.literal: Day guimao, Can was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, Can was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，璨貶登州刺史。

translations.literal: Day guichou, Can was demoted to prefect of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Can was demoted to prefect of Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 906 三年丙寅

translations.literal: 906 CE, third year, bingyin year.
translations.idiomatic: 906 CE, third year, bingyin year.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，全忠為諸道鹽鐵等使，判度支戶部事，充三司都制置使。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin, Quanzhong was made Commissioner for Salt and Iron in all circuits and related posts, took charge of the treasury and Ministry of Revenue, and served as Director of the Three Offices Disposal Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the third month, Quanzhong was made commissioner for salt and iron in all circuits and related posts, took charge of the treasury and Ministry of Revenue, and served as Director of the Three Offices Disposal Commission.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月丙寅，建削奪官爵。

translations.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, day bingyin, Jian was stripped of his titles and offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the intercalary twelfth month, Jian was stripped of his titles and offices.

sentences.zh: 907 四年丁卯

translations.literal: 907 CE, fourth year, dingmao year.
translations.idiomatic: 907 CE, fourth year, dingmao year.
